body.name: executable input-determined SA-CS-ID task machine
body.construction: Initialize the context kernels and worklist by the input-determined compiler and encode the resulting state by \(\operatorname{enc}_H\). At each nonterminal state, recompute the least applicable case from the current tasks under \(\mathfrak P_H\) and apply only its corresponding relation among \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}}\), \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}}\), \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}}\), and \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\). A nonresidual successor is admitted only after its finite graphical test, exact polynomial identity, and explicitly constructed ledger factorization have succeeded. The residual relation is scheduled exactly at the independently characterized recursive terminal/failure state; it halts only when its verifier accepts a projection or contrast candidate. The task-rank count vector \(\mu_H\), which realizes the finite multiset extension of the per-task order, is required to decrease at every nonresidual successor.
